description: A-F risk grade for one way to earn on XRP or RLUSD, from the XRP Yield Desk (xrplhub.io/yield): XRPL AMM pools, Doppler vaults, Firelight stXRP and other Flare FXRP products, RLUSD and XRP DeFi pools, and exchange earn programs. Returns the rate, size, lockup and withdrawal terms, who holds the keys, chain, age, audits, the data source with its timestamp, and every rule that moved the grade. General information, not advice; the products graded pay nothing. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.02 USDC on Base at GET /api/yield/grade. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not compute the grade. Find ids for free at https://www.xrplhub.io/api/yield/options. Params: id (option id, required).

id.description: Option id (slug) from https://www.xrplhub.io/api/yield/options, e.g. doppler-xrp-vault-xrpl. Required.

name: yield_grade
